nodes.name: Sklearn Binary Gaussian Process Classification Log Marginal Likelihood Shell Helpers
nodes.description: Deterministic _BinaryGaussianProcessClassifierLaplace.log_marginal_likelihood helpers for the theta-required-for-gradient guard, cached-value branch, kernel clone-versus-in-place selection, gradient-branch selection, and scalar-or-tuple result packaging above deferred kernel calls, posterior-mode callbacks, and gradient algebra.

nodes.name: gpc_binary_log_marginal_likelihood_require_theta_for_gradient
nodes.description: Reject eval_gradient when theta is omitted in binary GPC log-marginal-likelihood evaluation.

nodes.name: gpc_binary_log_marginal_likelihood_cached_result
nodes.description: Return the cached log-marginal-likelihood value when theta is None and no gradient is requested.

nodes.name: gpc_binary_log_marginal_likelihood_kernel
nodes.description: Resolve the kernel object used for binary GPC log-marginal-likelihood evaluation by cloning with theta or mutating theta in place.
nodes.type_signature: (kernel: Kernel, theta: NDArray[np.float64], clone_kernel: bool) -> Kernel

nodes.name: gpc_binary_log_marginal_likelihood_use_gradient_branch
nodes.description: Decide whether binary GPC log-marginal-likelihood evaluates the kernel with gradients.

nodes.name: gpc_binary_log_marginal_likelihood_result
nodes.description: Package the binary GPC log-marginal-likelihood output as a scalar when no gradient is requested or as a tuple when a gradient vector is supplied.
nodes.type_signature: (Z: float, eval_gradient: bool, gradient: NDArray[np.float64] | None = None) -> float | tuple[float, NDArray[np.float64]]
